description:
Unit: U4
Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-04-1314-refactor-jido-test-tree-plan.md#u4-reorganize-authoring-property-and-fixture-lanes

Outcome
Authoring, property, corpus, and fixture files use their final namespace owners.

Requirements and decisions
R1-R8, R10-R14; KTD1-KTD5, KTD7, KTD8.

Affected surfaces
test/authoring/**; test/property/**; test/fixtures/**; test/test_helper.exs; mix.exs; test/quality/component_proof.yml; test/quality/quality_contract.yml; test/quality/source_manifest.yml; and lane READMEs.

Implementation direction
Move the complete Agent and Flow corpus to test/authoring/{jido_agent,jido_flow} and explicit support to test/authoring/support/{jido_agent,jido_flow}. Move property families to test/property/{jido_agent_server,jido_expr,jido_signal} and Signal corpus to test/property/corpus/jido_signal. Keep test/fixtures/jido_ai as the flattened AI owner and keep inline_consumer as an isolated project. Rename executable and fixture modules under KTD3. Update only source-manifest target_path values and preserve historical source_path values.

Acceptance
Agent and Flow authoring run together and stay out of the default suite. Property and fuzz aliases select all three families from final paths. A focused property file uses only its family policy. Signal corpus replay and inline consumer compilation pass. Manifest targets exist and are unique.

Verification
mix test.authoring --warnings-as-errors
mix test.property --warnings-as-errors
mix test.fuzz --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
Authoring, property, and fixtures pass from final paths, manifest targets are current, and U5 can start.
title: U4 Reorganize authoring property and fixtures
